class.name: SimpleProgressChecker
class.description: Checks if the distance between the current and previous robot pose is above a minimum threshold within a time allowance.

class.name: PoseProgressChecker
class.description: Checks if the distance and angle between the current and previous robot pose is above a minimum threshold within a time allowance.

class.name: SimpleGoalChecker
class.description: Checks if the current pose is within the goal window for x, y and yaw.

class.name: StoppedGoalChecker
class.description: Checks linear and angular velocity after stopping at the goal.

class.name: PositionGoalChecker
class.description: Goal checker that only checks XY position and ignores orientation.

class.name: AdaptiveToleranceGoalChecker
class.description: Goal checker with two tolerance tiers: accepts a tight tolerance immediately, or a loose tolerance when the robot stops making progress.

class.name: AxisGoalChecker
class.description: Goal checker that checks progress along the axis defined by the last 2 poses of the path.

class.name: FeasiblePathHandler
class.description: Prunes the global plan around the robot and transforms the remaining portion into the local costmap global frame for local control.
